inputs.text: Taylor shutting down Hastie’s challenge makes the leadership contest look like a managed distraction: debate the personalities, but don’t touch the interests behind gas-company taxes and property-investor concessions. The same pattern shows up in Taylor’s refusal to criticize Trump or say whether he backs the US and Israel’s war with Iran. That vagueness isn’t neutrality—it keeps powerful allies comfortable and the real decisions shielded from public scrutiny.
